plan.english: Friend, I am afraid of the night. Why are you afraid? Night is the mother of the stars. Beasts and snakes come in the night. The dog is awake, and the fire burns; the two of them guard you. And at dawn the night goes away. Then I will lie down by the fire. Lie down, and may sleep come to you.
